high_attraction_beacons.title: SME_OVERDUE_PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_COMPILER
high_attraction_beacons.chinese_title: 中小企业逾期回款证据编译器
high_attraction_beacons.mechanism: A self-serve system ingests contract, delivery/acceptance, reconciliation, settlement and payment records; checks bounded eligibility and timing rules; identifies missing evidence; and compiles a structured complaint packet plus the correct official complaint path while failing closed on disputed or ambiguous legal questions.
high_attraction_beacons.operator_asset: Versioned complaint-evidence schema, rule-to-document mappings, deficiency taxonomy, and non-identifying workflow outcome telemetry that can improve packet completeness without requiring recurring founder judgment.
high_attraction_beacons.fail_closed_boundary: Do not represent users, promise recovery, decide genuinely disputed legal facts, or automate court/arbitration strategy. Ambiguous or disputed matters must route to qualified legal professionals.

examined_formations.title: GENERIC_SHARED_MANUFACTURING_CAPACITY_PLATFORM
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Real order decomposition and idle-capacity activation produce measurable value, but multiple current platforms already combine capacity listing, AI quoting, matching, workflow and settlement/collaboration.

examined_formations.title: SMALL_PROCESSOR_UNIFIED_PRIVACY_COMPLIANCE_FOR_MALLS_AND_PARKS
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The 2026 simplified personal-information rule creates a one-to-many compliance structure for managed commercial properties and parks, but exact buyer willingness for a lightweight software layer was not established.

examined_formations.title: ELECTRONIC_TRADE_DOCUMENT_TRANSITION_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The electronic-document transition is real, but banks, carriers, platform operators and existing document systems already occupy the execution surface.

examined_formations.title: SMALL_ENTERPRISE_SAFETY_STANDARD_COMPLIANCE_TOOL
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A new simplified small-enterprise safety standard exists, but mandatory adoption and exact payer pull were not established.
